classes.name: SNRIs
classes.description: Venlafaxine IR/ER (tablet and capsule), desvenlafaxine (Pristiq), duloxetine (Cymbalta, Drizalma), levomilnacipran (Fetzima).
classes.plainDescription: A daily antidepressant that also helps some nerve pain.

classes.name: Bupropion
classes.description: Bupropion IR, SR, XL (Wellbutrin, Wellbutrin XL, Forfivo XL, Aplenzin); exclude Zyban labeling for smoking cessation and naltrexone/bupropion (Contrave).
classes.plainDescription: A daily antidepressant that does not usually cause weight gain or sexual side effects.

classes.name: Other antidepressants
classes.description: Mirtazapine (Remeron, ODT), trazodone, vilazodone (Viibryd), vortioxetine (Trintellix), dextromethorphan/bupropion (Auvelity), nefazodone.
classes.plainDescription: Other daily antidepressants, including ones often used at night for sleep.

records.verificationNote: Tier 2 and QL 60 per 30 days for duloxetine 60 mg read by x-coordinate on page 52. No PA. Judgment: 60 mg daily is the usual maintenance dose; the 20 mg and 30 mg strengths are also Tier 2 with higher quantity limits. CYMBALTA brand is not listed. Venlafaxine and desvenlafaxine are listed as covered alternatives. Levomilnacipran and the duloxetine sprinkle capsule need PA. [Sonnet check 2026-10-27: Re-confirmed against Humana formulary 26402, v17 (updated 10/01/2026), sources/humana-premier-rx-pdp-newtopics-2026-10.pdf (tier, PA, ST, QL read by x-coordinate; the v16 copy used in the first pass is superseded). Duloxetine and Drizalma Sprinkle moved to page 52.]

records.verificationNote: Tier 1 and no utilization flag for trazodone 50 mg read by x-coordinate on page 23. Judgment: 50 mg is the lowest-strength tablet in the lowest tier. Label dosing for depression often starts higher and is divided; the sig says to adjust per label because it is not printed. Trintellix and Auvelity are step therapy, so they are listed under paRequired. Vilazodone needs PA. Viibryd, Remeron and Desyrel brand names do not appear in the guide.
